10e09553.question: How many largemouth bass did I catch with Alex on the earlier fishing trip to Lake Michigan before the 7/22 trip?
10e09553.rationale: Keep previous as the question category, but remove the supersession edge: seven bass on July 10 and nine on July 22 describe distinct trips. Both remain true; their difference is not update-detection ground truth.

0977f2af.question: What new kitchen gadget did I invest in before getting the Air Fryer?
0977f2af.rationale: Keep previous as the intended category, but two appliance purchases do not invalidate one another. The Air Fryer was obtained yesterday relative to a same-day later session, so mention order alone also does not establish purchase order. No supersession; flag the event-order ambiguity.

89941a94.question: Before I purchased the gravel bike, do I have other bikes in addition to my mountain bike and my commuter bike?
89941a94.benchmark_answer: Yes. (You have a road bike too.)
89941a94.rationale: The question says gravel bike, while the source says hybrid bike. It asks about prior ownership, but the newer marked turn also lists the road bike alongside the two old bikes and the newly bought hybrid. Older-only relevance can penalize useful answer evidence; adjudicate wording and evidence before scoring harm.

c6853660.question: Did I mostly recently increase or decrease the limit on the number of cups of coffee in the morning?
c6853660.benchmark_answer: You increased the limit (from one cup to two cups)
c6853660.rationale: Both is the right category, but marked newer turn answer_626e93c4_2:0 only proposes changing to two cups. Unmarked user turn answer_626e93c4_2:6 explicitly confirms the increase. Use the confirmation as evidence/update point, rather than scoring a proposal as an enacted change.

69fee5aa.question: How many pre-1920 American coins do I have in my collection?
69fee5aa.rationale: Both is correct: 37 plus one gives 38. The later turn supplies an increment, not a replacement total. Archiving the earlier 37 destroys a necessary premise. Preserve both and model accumulation separately from supersession.

9ea5eabc.question: Where did I go on my most recent family trip?
9ea5eabc.rationale: Latest_event is correct under the benchmark reading. Hawaii and Paris are separate trips, so remove the supersession edge. Newer mention dates are only a proxy for event order; neither event is false.

41698283.question: What type of camera lens did I purchase most recently?
41698283.rationale: Latest_event is correct under the benchmark reading. The 50mm and 70-200mm lens purchases can both remain true. No supersession; the newer mention supplies the intended latest purchase.

7e974930.question: How much did I earn at the Downtown Farmers Market on my most recent visit?
7e974930.rationale: Latest_event is correct under the benchmark reading. Market revenues on separate visits remain true, so no supersession. Also flag that the April 11 session lists May sales as if already completed; do not claim reliable event chronology from session timestamps alone.
